label: IRAN HITS KUWAIT
cons: War widens to a second Gulf host.

label: KERCH HIT AGAIN
cons: The 19 km Crimea link is shut again.

head: Kerch bridge struck again — third attack this week
deck: Traffic halted after a fresh attack on the Crimea link, days after a span was brought down.
chg: The 19 km Crimea link is shut again before Putin meets Trump and Xi.

head: Iran fires drones at a US base in Kuwait
deck: Tehran's first attack on Kuwait since September, after US jets hit a site on Qeshm Island.
chg: The war widens to a second Gulf host.

head: Trump, Xi and Putin meet — the first trilateral ever
deck: The three leaders sit down at Kylin Villa, Shenzhen, with nuclear limits and Iran on the table.
chg: No binding nuclear limits remain — New START expired in February.

head: Anthropic's $83 IPO is the biggest debut on record
chg: The AI boom's largest listing tops SpaceX's $75bn debut.

head: Russian strikes hit central Odesa; four killed, 13 hurt
chg: Russia hits Odesa the morning after the Kerch span fell.

head: Democrats nominate Jeffries 251–11
chg: Full House votes 3 Jan; Clark is first woman majority leader.

body: Coalition of the Willing meets in Berlin on Ukraine aid.
EU proposes a 45bn euro loan for Ukraine in 2027.
Israeli tanks cross the Yellow Line in central Gaza.
Nvidia stops shipping Hopper AI chips to China.
Fed minutes point to more rate rises; Waller backs a half-point hike.
Cyclone Akvan strengthens; Odisha lines up 200,000 to evacuate.
DR Congo Ebola passes 11,500 cases and 5,600 deaths.
Brent falls below $92 as US crude stocks rise 3.4m barrels.
